data.body: SC5(c) CARVE-OUT (Phase E adversarial review Finding #10): S3's integration-review skip on provenance is classified as a CONTRACT-PRESERVING BEHAVIOR CHANGE, not a pure additive change. The ci.yml:llm-review job invocation surface is unchanged, but its execution outcome (run vs. skip) is now data-dependent on verify-session-provenance.sh. This is acceptable under SC5(c) ONLY because the alternative outcome (running the review redundantly on already-covered commits) is the regression the epic is fixing. The doc-story (S_docs) records this carve-out in the ADR drafted by the epic's documentation pass.
